mapper.select: SELECT message, severity, enable FROM system_announcement WHERE id = 1
mapper.update: UPDATE system_announcement SET message = #{message}, severity = #{severity}, enable = #{enable} WHERE id = 1
mapper.sql: FROM status_management_event_history h INNER JOIN status_management_event e ON e.id = h.event_id INNER JOIN status_management_category c ON c.id = e.id_category

where.if: AND ( h.notes LIKE CONCAT('%', #{searchQuery}, '%') OR CONCAT('E-', YEAR(COALESCE(h.opened_date, e.updated_date)), '-', LPAD(e.id, 3, '0')) LIKE CONCAT('%', #{searchQuery}, '%') OR c.name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{searchQuery}, '%') )

mapper.select: SELECT e.id, e.id AS event_id, CONCAT('E-', YEAR(e.updated_date), '-', LPAD(e.id, 3, '0')) AS event_number, e.id_category AS category_id, c.name AS category_name, e.status, e.status_number, e.notes AS description, e.admin_notes, e.updated_by, 'closed' AS action_type, DATE_FORMAT(e.updated_date, '%b %e, %Y %l:%i %p') AS date_formatted, e.updated_date AS event_created_date, e.updated_date AS event_updated_date, e.updated_date AS event_closed_date, NULL AS duration_minutes, '-' AS duration_formatted, e.updated_date AS history_created_date FROM status_management_event e INNER JOIN status_management_category c ON c.id = e.id_category WHERE e.id = #{eventId} -- AND e.closed = 1 ORDER BY e.id DESC LIMIT 1

SELECT c.id, c.name, c.is_archived AS archived, CASE WHEN e.id IS NULL OR e.closed = 1 THEN 'Operational' ELSE e.status END AS status, CASE WHEN e.id IS NULL OR e.closed = 1 THEN NULL ELSE LPAD(e.id, 3, '0') END AS event, CASE WHEN e.id IS NULL OR e.closed = 1 THEN NULL ELSE e.id END AS eventId, CASE WHEN e.id IS NULL OR e.closed = 1 THEN NULL ELSE e.status_number END AS statusNumber, COALESCE(e.updated_date, c.updated_date) AS updated, e.notes AS note, NULLIF(e.admin_notes, '') AS admin FROM status_management_category c LEFT JOIN status_management_event e ON e.id = ( SELECT e1.id FROM status_management_event e1 WHERE e1.id_category = c.id ORDER BY e1.id DESC LIMIT 1 ) WHERE c.is_archived = #{archived} ORDER BY c.id ASC

SELECT c.id, c.name, c.is_archived AS archived, CASE WHEN e.id IS NULL OR e.closed = 1 THEN 'Operational' ELSE e.status END AS status, CASE WHEN e.id IS NULL OR e.closed = 1 THEN NULL ELSE LPAD(e.id, 3, '0') END AS event, CASE WHEN e.id IS NULL OR e.closed = 1 THEN NULL ELSE e.id END AS eventId, CASE WHEN e.id IS NULL OR e.closed = 1 THEN NULL ELSE e.status_number END AS statusNumber, DATE_FORMAT(COALESCE(e.updated_date, c.updated_date), '%b %e, %Y, %l:%i %p') AS updated, e.notes AS note, NULLIF(e.admin_notes, '') AS admin FROM status_management_category c LEFT JOIN status_management_event e ON e.id = ( SELECT e1.id FROM status_management_event e1 WHERE e1.id_category = c.id ORDER BY e1.id DESC LIMIT 1 ) WHERE c.id = #{id}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM status_management_category WHERE name = #{name}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO status_management_category(name, is_archived, updated_date) VALUES(#{name}, 0, NOW())
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM status_management_category WHERE id = #{id} AND is_archived = 1
mapper.select: SELECT e.id, e.id_category AS idCategory, e.status, e.notes, e.admin_notes AS adminNotes, e.updated_by AS updatedBy, e.status_number AS statusNumber FROM status_management_event e INNER JOIN status_management_category c ON c.id = e.id_category WHERE c.id = #{idCategory} AND e.id = ( SELECT e1.id FROM status_management_event e1 WHERE e1.id_category = #{idCategory} ORDER BY e1.id DESC LIMIT 1 ) AND e.closed = 0 LIMIT 1

SELECT e.id, e.id_category AS idCategory, e.status, e.notes, e.admin_notes AS adminNotes, e.updated_by AS updatedBy, e.status_number AS statusNumber FROM status_management_event e INNER JOIN status_management_category c ON c.id = e.id_category WHERE e.id = #{id} AND e.closed = 0 AND c.is_archived = 0 LIMIT 1
mapper.update: UPDATE status_management_event SET status = #{status}, notes = #{notes}, admin_notes = #{adminNotes}, status_number = #{statusNumber}, updated_by = #{updatedBy}, updated_date = NOW() WHERE id = #{id} AND closed = 0

UPDATE status_management_event SET status = 'Operational', notes = #{notes}, admin_notes = #{adminNotes}, status_number = #{statusNumber}, updated_by = #{updatedBy}, updated_date = NOW(), closed = 1 WHERE id = #{id} AND closed = 0
